question: If we define the cut-off point to diagnose renal failure through the Glomerular Filtering Index (GFR) as 15 ml / min instead of 60 ml / min it is increasing:

options.opc: The Positive Predictive Value of the IFG.
options.opd: The Negative Predictive Value of the IFG.
options.ope: The internal and external validity of the IFG.

analysis: By lowering the cut-off point for diagnosing renal failure through GFR from 60 ml/min to 15 ml/min, it will increase the sensitivity of the test as more true positive cases will be correctly identified. However, this may also lead to an increase in false positives.
